doc.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Lieb Up Close, Moses's Gramavision date and Jill McManus
summary: Quick comments on a Steve Satten swing date, a Bob Moses Gramavision record and Jill McManus's Hopi-based album.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: A couple of dates for our friend Steve Satten for Contempo Vibrato, one with Jimmy Cobb, one under your name called Lieb Up Close.
Yep. Booker, Larry Willis, and Jimmy Cobb, swingin’ record. And Steve. Steve is on a couple tracks.
Here’s a big date with Moses: Visit with the Great Spirit, for Gramavision.
One of his, for Gramavision. He somehow got a contract, just the one record, a Moses production.
The date with Jill McManus where she did the Indian tune.
Indian Hopi stuff. Just saw her recently. She came somewhere. We reminisced about that. She had this Hopi – she went to Arizona, and she picked up chants. Gomez. I think Bruce Ditmas.
